This page is a **gauge**. It is not a forecast, not a relocation brief, and not permission to build or inhabit anything.

Two other pages exist on purpose:

- [Coupling Register](articles/book-one-coupling-register.qmd) — **which claims are allowed**. That file wins if this page disagrees.
- [Coupling Monitor](articles/coupling-monitor.qmd) — older Niño / EONET / USGS M6 snapshot. Not yet the same database as the numbers below.

Human review required. No autonomous control of water, power, or public safety.

## Can we see it?

| What | Informs claim | Can we see it? | Latest honest state |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rain at 9 points (CHIRPS) | Water joint; **not** CL-002 | Yes, 1991–2020 monthly | Current calendar month often **DELAYED** (last file 2026.07) |
| Temp + rain (ERA5) | Air / Water context | Yes, 1991–2020 monthly | Complete on those points |
| Quakes M4.5+ tropics vs north/south | Earth joint | Yes, 1991–2020 monthly | Complete |
| Satellite hotspots (FIRMS) | Fire joint | Partial | **4,968** on 2026-08-30; **western-southern box returned 0 — that is a hole, not “no fire”** |
| Niño 3.4 / ONI | Air; used in RQ5 v0 only | Yes, CPC text file | ONI MJJ 2026 = **+1.39** (observation, not a cascade) |
| AMOC / RAPID (CL-002) | CL-002 stays **PILOT** | Not in this job | Do not read rain here as AMOC |
| Volcanic winter (CL-016) | **PARKED** | Not claimed | Absent on purpose |
| EDEN habitability | Pre-feasibility spec elsewhere | **No** from these 9 points | Forbidden reading |

## Rain vs a real El Niño index (RQ5 v0 — not a cause)

Question asked: in DJF 1992–2020, does CHIRPS rain at a point move with CPC ONI more than a **year-shuffled null**?

| Place | Correlation r | p vs shuffle | What you may say |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Ubay | −0.77 | 0.000 | Stronger than chance **in this test**. Not “El Niño dries the Philippines.” |
| Manaus | −0.51 | 0.002 | Same rule. |
| Nairobi | +0.49 | 0.003 | Opposite sign. One ocean index is not one tropics. |
| Jakarta | −0.27 | 0.17 | Not distinguished from null. |
| Lagos | −0.20 | 0.29 | Null. |
| Mumbai | +0.07 | 0.72 | Null. |
| Paris | −0.18 | 0.37 | Control behaved like noise. |

This test **does not change CL-002**.

## How to read a number

1. What instrument? 2. What month vs **that month’s** 1991–2020 mean? 3. Is the source late or empty? 4. Which claim ID, if any, is allowed to move?

If those four are missing, treat the number as decoration.

Credits: CHIRPS/UCSB, ERA5/ECMWF via Open-Meteo, USGS, EMSC, BMKG, NASA FIRMS, CPC ONI.
